QUOTE: "Saves that pending state, then calls `client.createPost` once more. ... On failure, either removes the post (for the same three errors) or sets `props.failed` again so the user can retry. Each retry is a single manual attempt."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says `retryFailedPost` makes one new `createPost` call, with no loop or HTTP retries. On failure it removes the post for the same three errors or marks it failed again.
